d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To function as a Commis Chef for Calo UAE’s On-Demand QSR Kitchen. Support the kitchen team by executing daily preparation, cooking, and assembly tasks to meet Calo’s nutritional and speed standards. The successful candidate will play a critical role in maintaining high production efficiency and ensuring every order leaves the kitchen accurately prepared and on time.
Works under the guidance of senior chefs and CDPs in the Section
Works closely with the Kitchen Management, Production Leads to support workflow efficiency and production consistency
Shift based work, based in high volume environments with mandatory personal protective equipment during all production operation times
q: Proven experience as a Commis 2 or Commis 3 in QSR or high volume restaurants (2 - 4 years minimum)
Proficient with basic health and safety ,Haccap standards (certification preferred)
Understanding of basic preparations and cooking techniques
Ability to work in a fast paced, high volume production environment
Proficient with communication in English and working in a team
Passion for quality and continuous improvements
Able to be a team player for your peers and be the best version of yourself
Obsession with delivering a high level of customer satisfaction
r: Assist the Commis 1 and senior chefs in the daily execution of kitchen operations, prep and service work
Execute cooking, assembly, and preparations with consistency and efficiency in a fast-paced environment
Follow daily production and service plans to ensure the timely delivery of prepared hot meals
Align with the fast-paced nature of QSR service while maintaining Calo's quality and nutritional guidelines
Ensure precise portioning to align with Calo’s calories and macronutrient guidelines
Minimize waste through effective practice of storage, labeling and rotation of ingredients along with smart yield optimization
Maintain routine due diligence checks adhering to HACCP standards along with sanitation and safety protocols

d: Citigroup Saudi Arabia offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of the Kingdom's dynamic financial markets. We are seeking a driven Operations Analyst for our Cash Equity Brokerage team, where you will play a critical role in supporting our equity trading desk and contributing to our success in the region.

We are specifically seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Operations Analyst to support the MENA equity trading desk, with a focus on the Saudi market. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver with a passion for finance and a commitment to operational excellence. You will play a key part in ensuring the smooth and efficient processing of trades, managing client accounts, and mitigating risk.
q: A minimum of a Bachelor's degree specifically in Finance.
Fluency in English (both written and spoken).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with traders, clients, and custodians.
A strong analytical mindset with a high level of attention to detail.
Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Previous experience in a brokerage or custody environment.
An understanding of the specificities of Saudi Equity brokerage.

r: Provide dedicated operational support to the equity trading desk for all Saudi trading activities.
Manage the end-to-end process of client account creation and maintenance.
Coordinate with custodians for pre-confirmation of trades to ensure timely settlement.
Handle client confirmations, ensuring accuracy and prompt delivery.
Perform daily stock and cash reconciliations to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Monitor commission payments and ensure they are correctly calculated and processed.
Engage in proactive risk management by identifying potential operational risks and implementing mitigation strategies.
Deliver exceptional service to our customers, addressing inquiries and resolving issues effectively.
Contribute to business enablement by maintaining and enhancing operational excellence.

d: Support governance reporting activities by preparing, analyzing, and maintaining governance-related reports, dashboards, and management information to facilitate effective oversight and decision-making.

Provide analytical support for governance committees, leadership reporting, and governance performance monitoring while ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with governance requirements.
Contribute to continuous improvement of governance reporting processes, reporting frameworks, and information management practices.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Corporate Governance, Finance, Management, Economics, Law, Information Systems, or a related field.
GRCP, CGI/ICSA Governance Qualification, CRMA, PMP, or equivalent certification preferred.
5–8 years of experience in governance, reporting, compliance, risk management, corporate secretariat, business reporting, or related disciplines.
Preparing governance reports, dashboards, and management information.
Supporting governance committees, leadership reporting, and performance monitoring activities.
Collecting, validating, and analyzing business or governance data.
Coordinating with stakeholders across multiple business functions.
Supporting governance reviews, audits, and compliance-related reporting requirements.
r: Prepare and maintain governance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and management information for governance committees and leadership teams.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze governance-related data from various business functions and reporting sources.
Monitor governance actions, decisions, performance indicators, and reporting obligations to ensure accurate status tracking and reporting.
Support the preparation of governance committee reports, executive summaries, presentations, and briefing materials.
Maintain governance reporting templates, databases, trackers, and document repositories.
Review reporting submissions for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with governance requirements.
Analyze governance trends, reporting outcomes, action plan progress, and key performance indicators to support management decision-making.
Coordinate with business units and stakeholders to obtain reporting information and resolve data quality issues.
Support governance reviews, audits, and compliance assessments by providing governance-related reports and supporting documentation.
Assist in developing reporting enhancements, automation opportunities, and dashboard improvements to strengthen reporting effectiveness.
Ensure confidentiality and proper management of sensitive governance information and records.
Contribute to governance process improvement initiatives and the implementation of governance best practices.
